 messages=[{'role':'system','content':ADJUSTMENT_INSTRUCTION},{'role':'user','content':json.dumps({'candidate_response':'Try one slow breath before you speak.'})}]
 dec={'temperature':0,'max_tokens':256,'stop':[],'chat_template_kwargs':{'enable_thinking':False}}

 result=t.complete(arm,messages,[],dec);out.append({'structured':structured,'result':result});print(out[-1],flush=True)
write(OUTPUT/'adjustment-diagnostic/results.json',out)
